g.text: openmeet-core: claims, topics, action items and screen context (types.rs)
owner and due are filled from the meeting: due is
kept as said ("by Friday"), never a calendar date.
Workplace mode can fill a missing owner or due later.
Pending: not discussed yet (planned or suggested)
Raw screenshots are never part of it.
frame ready for OCR/vision. Not serialized,
lives only in memory. png = downscaled frame,
